thread:
eli: Heads up — after the CUDA 12.4.p2 + Triton 2.1.4 uplift we saw a KV-cache latency spike on small-sequence workloads in staging. 95p went from ~45ms to ~120ms on a100-p3.

neha: Ugh. Is it across all models or a subset? any CI perf failures?

eli: Mostly short context (<=64) generation workload and chat paths that hit KV hot prefix. CI perf job for runtime-smoke shows perf-failure on smallseq-bench: +2.6x 95p, link: https://ci/redwood/jobs/2345

samir: I ran quick profiler. Kernel selection flipped for matmul path — triton started preferring "matmul_autofast_v2" PTX on ptx_750 rather than our tuned tiled kernel. Flamegraph attached below.

samir: ```
# perf summary (short context)
old (cuda12.4p1, triton 2.1.3): tiled_matmul_kernel 68%
new (cuda12.4p2, triton 2.1.4): matmul_autofast_v2 82%
KV memcpy / cudaMemcpyAsync latency increased 3-4x
```

neha: can you paste the kernel selector logs from the serving runtime? want to see why selector cost model changed.

eli: paste: ```
[2026-03-16 14:12:03] kernel_selector: chosen=matmul_autofast_v2 score=12.3 alt=tiled_matmul score=11.8 note=ptx_warp_reduce_enabled
[2026-03-16 14:12:03] kvcache: prefetch_latency=0.92ms -> 3.6ms after upgrade
```

pri: This is blocking the staged rollout, QA flagged regression. Can we force fallback to the old tiled kernel until bisect/repro?

samir: quick bisect points to Triton commit 6b3f9e that changed PTX dispatch heuristics + a small nvrtc behavior in cuda driver 555.42 -> 555.47. Repro locally with triton 2.1.4 + cuda12.4p2.

neha: two-pronged plan: 1) temporary runtime override to prefer tiled_matmul for shapes < 256x256 2) deeper perf bisect with CUDA NVRTC flags and kernel microbenchmarks.

eli: override config I pushed to staging (rollout paused): ```json
{
  "kernel_selector_overrides": {
    "matmul": {
      "prefer": "tiled_matmul",
      "conditions": "seq_len <= 64 && batch <= 8"
    }
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: Deploy paused: rollout id r-2026-03-16-89 halted due to perf regressions (see incident #IR-512).

pri: After override, 95p restored to ~50ms on staging. Can we ship override as hotfix and open PR to upstream selector?

neha: yes. I'll file perf issue against Triton with microbench traces and a reduced repro. samir/eli to prepare kernel microbench and nvrtc repro matrix (driver versions 555.42/555.47, triton 2.1.3/2.1.4).

samir: noted. I'll also run a KV cache stress with repeated prefix hits to ensure no other regressions.

eli: action items: neha -> issue + triage, samir -> microbench and bisect logs, pri -> coordinate hotfix release (runtime override) and confirm rollout gates.

pri: tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

eli: thanks — will follow up with perf numbers.

(ended)
